The team's head coach was [[Bruce Pearl]] in his 10th season at Auburn. The team played its home games at [[Neville Arena]] in [[Auburn, Alabama]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] with a record of 21–13, 10–8 in [[Southeastern Conference]] play to finish in seventh place in the conference. As the No. 7 seed, they were defeated by No. 10 seed [[2022–23 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] in the second round of the [[2023 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. The Tigers received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 9 seed in the Midwest Region, where they defeated [[2022–23 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]] in the First Round before falling to the region's top seed [[2022–23 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the Second Round.
